global: pizzicato strings, bouncy bass, glockenspiel, brass stabs, snare, light timpani

sections.name: hook
sections.style: bold heroic brass fanfare with timpani, triumphant entrance, big cymbal swell

sections.name: coat
sections.style: curious sparkling wonder: glockenspiel and pizzicato, a little rocket-launch whoosh build, ends bright

sections.name: test
sections.style: brave determined march: snare, bouncy tuba and brass, rising tension, tiptoe up the stairs, ends on a proud hit

sections.name: inside
sections.style: sudden hush: soft cool celesta and airy strings, calm and cosy, then a comic dry stop

sections.name: feet
sections.style: comic panic: frantic hot-foot pizzicato, slide whistles, kazoo-like woodwinds, hopping rhythm, ending with a cheerful ding

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm playful outro, bouncy pizzicato and glockenspiel melody, little heroic brass button ending
